summary: Replace each public job-board snapshot atomically only after the response proves a complete jobs array and every listed posting has an ID; sort before applying a result limit.
reason: A partial response, missing posting ID, or failed cleanup can otherwise erase or mix saved jobs, and limiting before sorting can hide the newest matching posting.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests cover missing and empty jobs arrays, newest-first limits, invalid posting IDs, and rollback when snapshot cleanup fails.
